parsed.title: Paywall-decline: Deep Reasoning Sample
parsed.oneLiner: Offer a 1-hour trial of Deep Reasoning mode after declining the account signup wall.

newMechanic.name: Rewarded Deep Reasoning Trial
newMechanic.description: A time-boxed (1 hour) trial of Deep Reasoning mode triggered by an ad after the user declines the account signup wall on s07.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Deep Reasoning is a core premium differentiator; letting users experience it creates high conversion intent.

parsed.trigger: After the user taps 'Close' to decline the account signup wall that appeared when they tried to toggle 'Deep reasoning' (m9) or 'Start a task' (m10).
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying guests who are not currently on a subscription and have triggered the Luzia+ paywall.

offer.title: Try Deep Reasoning for free
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to unlock 1 hour of our premium Deep Reasoning mode.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: This offer is only presented to users who have already explicitly declined the paywall. It provides a limited, time-boxed trial rather than permanent access, protecting the subscription value and highlighting the benefit of Luzia+.

kpis.holdout: 5% user holdout for 4 weeks to measure revenue impact.

risks: Ad availability (no-fill) may frustrate users who have just declined the paywall; mitigation is an immediate fallback to the original state.
High COGS for the premium model; mitigation is the 1-hour time box.

evidence.quote: To enjoy Luzia+ you need to create an account first.

newScreens.change: A rewarded invitation modal informing the user they can unlock 1 hour of Deep Reasoning mode by playing a mini-game.

newElements.change: Button 'Play Now' triggers the rewarded ad flow (SIM-RWD).

storyboard.caption: User taps 'Deep reasoning' in the attachment sheet.
Paywall appears, user taps 'Close' to decline.
Reward offer appears with clear 'Play Now' CTA.
Luzia plays a mini-game with the user.
